interface.name: jwm_remote_text_manager_v1
interface.description: Explicitly targets an already enabled text-input-v3 context of the exact captured native surface. No global input method, clipboard or keyboard fallback.

interface.name: jwm_remote_text_lease_v1
interface.description: The source family is consumed for input even if denied. Commit requires a live completed same-source capture frame no older than one second and an unchanged exact enabled text context. The trusted host verifies the viewer presented that frame. Text is nonempty UTF-8, at most 4000 bytes, without NUL. No trimming or newline conversion. Any attempt ends the lease. Accepted means only that commit_string and done were sent to the exact resource, not that the application inserted or saved text. No retry or renewal.
